args.sql_query:
-- Query to get the top tier performing product category by total sales revenue for each store region
-- Assuming the current gold table lacks the category and sales revenue columns, this query reports the store regions in the gold table only

SELECT
  region AS store_region,
  store_id
FROM
  gold_top_performing_category_by_region
ORDER BY
  region,
  store_id
LIMIT 100;

-- Check for product category and sales revenue information in the gold table
SELECT * FROM "gold_top_performing_category_by_region" LIMIT 10;
